email_draft.subject: Real-time platform drives governance and security
email_draft.body:
Hi there,

Salesforce is shaping a governance-friendly, real-time data platform. Here are three evidence-backed signals for CIO outcomes:

- Q2 FY2026 shows subscription and support revenue up 11% YoY, underscoring how an integrated platform with real-time signals supports governance decisions.

- The Zero Copy Partner Network enables secure, bidirectional integration with Salesforce Data Cloud, strengthening data integration and security across partner data flows.

- Agentforce APIs and developer resources enable secure, real-time integration on the Salesforce platform, helping accelerate deployment.

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call to discuss a real-time KPI dashboard tying revenue drivers to platform usage for governance decisions?
